text:
maria g.: hey team, excited to start! I'm blocked on Okta SSO. I installed Okta Verify but when I try to enroll it fails: 'Enrollment failed: invalid token'. Also trying to open the 1Password invite just asks me to create a standalone password rather than 'Sign in with Okta'. anyone seen this?
it-support: welcome, maria! first guess: provisioning hasn't landed for your account yet (SCIM delay) or the Okta setup token expired. can you confirm you're using maria.g@redwood.com and paste the exact error screen? also try signing in at https://redwood.okta.com directly.
maria g.: yes it's maria.g@redwood.com. error is exactly: `Enrollment failed: invalid token (E_INV_TOKEN)` and the web enroll flow spins then shows "Something went wrong". tried Chrome and Brave.
lara: pinging infra-admin to check SCIM/group assignment. maria, i'll also DM you the onboarding checklist and welcome packet.
infra-admin: checking SCIM now 527. looks like your user was created but not in the "employee-core" group so Google Workspace & 1Password app assignments didn't apply. i've manually added you to employee-core and resent app assignments + 1Password invite. also forced an Okta factor reset for you. you should get a new QR.
josh: fwiw i saw the same invalid token when my first invite sat >24h before I clicked it. Okta tokens expire pretty fast. If you still see problems, try incognito and make sure any adblocker/popup blocker is off.
maria g.: got a new QR after the reset. scanned it but Okta Verify says "Time skew detected" when I try to verify the push. phone is iPhone 14, iOS up to date.
it-support: time skew usually means the phone clock is off. Go to Settings > General > Date & Time and toggle "Set Automatically" on. If that doesn't work, uninstall/reinstall Okta Verify and retry the QR flow.
maria g.: toggled time sync, reinstalled Okta Verify, approval worked and I'm logged into Okta. Google Workspace sign-in still initially gave "Account not provisioned" but now that also works after the manual add. 1Password invite though still opens "create a master password" page instead of SSO.
it-support: for 1Password we prefer SSO via Okta. On the invite page click "Sign in with SSO / Sign in with Okta" link. If it goes to an email/password create flow, that means the invite wasn't SSO-bound; i've reissued a "SSO-enforced" invite now. try that link and let us know. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/internal/onboarding/1password-sso
onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood, maria! :wave: Quick checklist:
- Okta sign-in confirmed
- Okta Verify enrolled
- Google Workspace access
- 1Password SSO invite accepted
Join #team-eng and #new-hires for socials.
maria g.: ok the SSO-enforced invite worked, clicked "Sign in with Okta" and it used my Okta session. all set! thanks everyone, excited to be here :heart:
